title: Firehose: S3 delivery with time-partitioned keys, retries & spool
aws_equivalent: Kinesis Data Firehose (S3 destination, retry, error output)

user_story.i_want: each flushed batch written to S3 under an hourly-partitioned key, retried on failure
user_story.so_that: files are discoverable by hour and transient storage errors don't lose data

description: Build `S3BatchSink` on the stratum-aws client. The key follows docs/architecture.md, with the hour taken from the batch's `opened_at` in UTC. Set ContentType `application/x-ndjson` and ContentEncoding `gzip`. Implement retries yourself: exponential backoff with jitter up to a configurable `retry_duration` (default 5 min). If that is exhausted, spool the batch to local disk (`./var/firehose-spool/`); a startup task re-delivers spooled files.

acceptance_criteria.given: a batch opened at 10:59:59Z and flushed at 11:00:05Z

acceptance_criteria.then: keys within a stream sort lexicographically in time order

acceptance_criteria.given: RustFS is stopped, then restarted within retry_duration
acceptance_criteria.then: retries are logged with attempt numbers and the object is eventually written
it is spooled to disk, and on the next start it is delivered and the spool file removed
it writes a batch and reads it back intact

rust_concepts: Classifying SDK errors as retryable or not
